description: Land Title Settlement Department  - Mabodala, Minuwangoda D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510401 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in various villages in the Gampaha District. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
